description: This file implements a TCP-based distributed key-value store backend for PyTorch, including classes and methods for managing background threads, socket communication, and handling various store operations such as set, get, delete, and wait. It also manages socket events and thread synchronization for a distributed environment.

classes.name: BackgroundThread
classes.description: Base class for managing background threads with start, stop, and dispose methods.

classes.name: TCPStoreMasterDaemon
classes.description: Derived class implementing a TCP server for distributed key-value store operations, handling socket events, and managing store data and client requests.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Stops the thread and joins it, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the background thread.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the listening port of the TCP store.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop handling socket events, accepting connections, and processing store requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the thread to stop running.

methods.name: initStopSignal
methods.description: Initializes the stop signal mechanism (event or pipe).

methods.name: closeStopSignal
methods.description: Closes the stop signal handle or pipe.

methods.name: queryFds
methods.description: Processes active file descriptors for socket events.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles a specific socket query based on the received query type.

methods.name: validateHandler
methods.description: Validates a client connection.

methods.name: pingHandler
methods.description: Responds to a ping request.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Handles setting a key-value pair in the store.

methods.name: compareSetHandler
methods.description: Handles compare-and-set operation.

methods.name: addHandler
methods.description: Handles adding a numeric value to a key.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key.

methods.name: getNumKeysHandler
methods.description: Returns the number of keys in the store.

methods.name: deleteHandler
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: checkHandler
methods.description: Checks if keys exist in the store.

methods.name: waitHandler
methods.description: Handles wait requests for keys to be set.

methods.name: appendHandler
methods.description: Appends data to an existing key.

methods.name: multiGetHandler
methods.description: Retrieves multiple keys.

methods.name: multiSetHandler
methods.description: Sets multiple keys.

methods.name: cancelWaitHandler
methods.description: Cancels a wait request.

methods.name: listKeysHandler
methods.description: Lists all keys in the store.

methods.name: addMiscellaneousSocket
methods.description: Marks a socket as miscellaneous.

methods.name: removeMiscellaneousSocket
methods.description: Removes a socket from miscellaneous set.

methods.name: isMiscellaneousSocket
methods.description: Checks if a socket is marked as miscellaneous.

methods.name: checkKeys
methods.description: Checks if all specified keys exist in the store.

methods.name: wakeupWaitingClients
methods.description: Notifies clients waiting on a key that it has been set.

methods.name: doSet
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair and wakes up waiting clients.
